```{python}
#| include: false
# Slide figures: the format's figure style and its vendored Libre Franklin.
# Delete this chunk in a deck with no executed figures. A dark deck uses
# ssus-slides-dark.mplstyle.
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager

ext = next(p / "_extensions/ssus-slides" for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents]
           if (p / "_extensions/ssus-slides").is_dir())
for f in ext.glob("fonts/LibreFranklin-*.ttf"):
    font_manager.fontManager.addfont(f)
plt.style.use(ext / "ssus-slides.mplstyle")
```
